# ThunderStudy AI

ThunderStudy AI is a free educational AI project run by Wondermayank, a solo student developer building free educational tools since 2018.

- [Home](https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/): Explore the AI study tools and educational experiences.
- [About](https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about.html): Learn who runs the project, its mission and what it offers.
- [FAQ](https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq.html): Short answers about the site, tools, accounts, support and ads.
- [Changelog](https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/changelog.html): Newest-first record of project updates.
- [Updates](https://ai.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new.html): Alternate public copy of the changelog.

Last updated: 2026-10-02.
